authForms.title: Auth Forms
authForms.description: Sign in, sign up, password reset, and email verification — every flow ships as Form, Card, or Modal so you can drop the right primitive in any layout.

authButtons.title: Auth Buttons
authButtons.description: Drop-in CTAs that route to the hosted auth flow — login, register, OAuth, magic link.

userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: User menu, avatar, account modal, settings, sessions, and OAuth-providers management — everything that lives behind the user dropdown.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Pre-composed dashboards: end-user, admin, and the federated EZAuth shell that powers the @ezstart hub.

applicationsKeys.title: Applications & Keys
applicationsKeys.description: Application CRUD, the Developer Portal, API key tables, usage badges, and the create / created modals.

guardsBanners.title: Guards & Banners
guardsBanners.description: Auth guards, loaders, and the system-wide banners (maintenance, dev mode, scope context, error).

security.title: Security
security.description: Password strength meter, Turnstile widget, and the two-factor settings + prompt.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Audit log section — drop-in surface for security-relevant events on a user account.
